Name: (CP)Happy Birthday Zayne
Author: LS950905
Description:
关于mod💙
这是[恋与深空 黎深]的同人创作，是送给黎深单推和黎深的礼物。祝黎深生日快乐，小茉莉和黎深永远幸福~
mod包含的家具、装饰摆件、地板和墙面等均为黎深属性。
地板和墙面见(CP)ZayneWallpaperAndFloor（36815）。
装饰摆件均支持室内室外摆放。

⚠️温馨提示：该mod是独属于黎深和小茉莉的回忆，请勿将此mod与恋与深空其他男主的mod（尤其是角色mod）同时使用。对黎深和小茉莉有恶意的人请勿使用。

需要前置安装：
SMAPI
SpaceCore
Content Patcher(CP)
Json Assets (JA)

如何取出物品
推荐使用CJB Item Spawner将物品添加到游戏（使用家具目录也可以添加物品）。


制作者的碎碎念：
这是我的第一个模组，是在时间有限、技术还不太熟练的情况下完成的。因此，里面的物品都不支持转向。“窗户”是作为一个装饰摆件实现的，底部有占位，也不会随白天黑夜自动变化。但不妨碍视觉效果。
期待茉的黎深痛房！有黎深在，老乡茉种田更有动力了！


[b]About this Mod[/b] 💙
Inside this mod you’ll find Zayne-themed furniture, decorations, flooring, and wallpapers.
Zayne-themed floors and walls can be found in (CP)ZayneWallpaperAndFloor (36815).
Every decorations can be placed both indoors and outdoors, so you can surround yourself with Zayne’s presence anywhere you like. 

Requirements:
SMAPI
SpaceCore
Content Patcher(CP)
Json Assets (JA)

How to get the items:
Use CJB Item Spawner to add them into your game.(The furniture catalog can also be used to obtain the items)

From the creator:
This is my very first mod, and I made it with limited time and beginner skills.
Because of that, the items don’t support rotations.
The “window” is made as a decorative item with a footprint, and it won’t change between day and night— but the visual effect is still there
With Zayne around, farming in Stardew feels so much more motivating! 🌸


⚠️A gentle note: This mod is something special, just for Zayne and Little Jasmine.
Please don’t use it together with mods for the other male leads in Love and Deepspace (especially character mods).
And if you don’t share the love for Zayne and Little Jasmine, this mod probably isn’t for you.
